product_metadata.title: Umbra Mini Waste Can, 1-1/2 Gallon with Swing Lid (Gloss Black)
features: Compact, contemporary swing-top waste can designed for small spaces and under-cabinet use
Constructed of recycled polypropylene with a high-gloss finish
Removable, swing-top lid for easy use Size: 7-1/2-inch diameter by 12-1/2-inch high; 1-1/2 gallon (5 L) capacity
description: Designed to fit under a cabinet but attractive enough to sit in plain view, the Mini swing-top waste can from Umbra features a removable, swinging lid, durable recycled-polypropylene construction, and a sleek, high-gloss finish. Can measures 7-1/2-inch in diameter by 12-1/2-inch tall with a 1-1/2-gallon (5 L) capacity. Designed by Umbra Design Group- original, modern, casual, functional and affordable design for the home.
